title: 2 in a pack, only one worked.
text: 2 in a pack, only one worked.. The battery pack was partially opened for one of the lights, and the plastic battery protector was out of place.  This killed the battery on the remote control.  The one that works is pretty and my daughter loves it.  I have to replace the battery of one of the controllers which makes it not so great of a value.

product_metadata.title: Digitblue Hanging Starburst Light 2 Pack, 8 Modes Holiday Mood Firework Lights for Outdoor Indoor Festival Decoration, Waterproof 120 LEDs, Warm White …
features: WIDELY USE: This led string light designed as a bouquet shape will illuminate any dark corner and Can be hung on walls, windows, doors, ceilings, Christmas trees etc. Decorate for Party,Wedding, Festival, Shows, Restaurant, Hotel, Commercial Building, Shopping Center, Pub, Concert, Hall and so on.
EASY TO SHAPE: 2 copper wire are twisted into 1 wire, the string is flexible and can be easily shaped and molded however you want.
WATERPROOF: All parts of this string lights are waterproof. They can work excellently even on rainy days.

REMOTE CONTROL: 60 Branches 120 LED Micro Lights with 8 functions remote controller. Control the lights remotely with 10 brightness levels and 8 different modes (steady/blinking/flash/smooth/strobe, etc). The remote control allows you to set times, 6 hours on and 18 hours off automatically.
TIPS: 4 x AA battery required(battery not included). Wireless remote control, effective receiving range is 10 meter.
